trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, MC No.6475/2019
case_name: Smt. Nagamani @ Geetha M.K vs Sri. Ramu V
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking dissolution of marriage on grounds of cruelty and desertion. The trial court allowed the petition. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle disputes amicably and withdraw allegations.
legal_principles.held: At the intervention of elders and well-wishers, the appellant-wife and the respondent-husband have arrived at an amicable settlement of the dispute and accordingly they have filed a joint memo.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree to withdraw pending cases in the context of a settlement.
legal_principles.held: The appellant agreed to withdraw the said case by the appellant while withdrawing the said case, the respondent agreed to give Rs.5,00,000/- in favour of the appellant.

outcome.final_order: The parties arrived at an amicable settlement and the divorce judgment was passed with a condition that the respondent-husband pays total permanent alimony of Rs.11,00,000/- to the appellant-wife.

use_for_drafting: advising on Hindu Marriage Act provisions
